name: api.openvibe.network
description: api.openvibe.network is the planned home of the network's public APIs. The ecosystem registry (services, capabilities, event topics, namespaces and releases, backed by the OpenVibe contracts) already answers on openvibe.network; this subdomain is not routed to it yet.

pillars.text: Every service, its domains, health and maturity, in one catalog.

pillars.title: Capabilities
pillars.text: Action-level permissions apps and mods can request and be granted.

pillars.title: Event topics
pillars.text: Durable event families and their schemas.

pillars.title: Releases
pillars.text: Release manifests and compatibility ranges per service.
